reference.answer: NEED_MB defaults to 28600: the peak of d2 (25.42 GiB) + the floor of the watch (2 GiB) + 0.5 GiB.

evidence.quote: NEED_MB=${NEED_MB:-28600}   # the peak of d2 (25.42 GiB) + the floor of the watch (2 GiB) + 0.5 GiB
